data.long_meaning: Murawwih is an Arabic name derived from the root 'rww', which means 'to be devoted to Allah'. It is a name given to those who are deeply committed to their faith and strive to live in obedience to Allah's commands. The name Murawwih carries the meaning “One who is devoted to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Murawwih usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is devoted to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
